learned: The governed studio-memory-graph section passed six of seven chunks but reproduced a Windows PermissionError when a workflow observer read resources.json concurrently with a worker mutation. ResourceLedger writes hold the cross-process FileLock, while load only holds an instance-local RLock and therefore does not honor the writer exclusion boundary.
next_action: Reproduce the documented startup path, trace the first real failure to its canonical owner, and repair successive blockers without running certification early.

evidence.claim: Governed receipt captures the concurrent Windows PermissionError in workflow lifecycle observation.
